title: Eligibility Category Schedule for Prior Authorization Extension Units
content:
The units a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension adds — the units granted by extension when the extension is recorded — carry a population addition that follows the eligibility category of the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership.

| Eligibility category on the Medicaid Managed Care Membership | Units added to the units the extension adds |
|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 3 |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 3 |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | 1 |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | 1 |
| any other eligibility category | 0 |

The addition is made once to the units the extension adds, before the floor of zero and the ceiling of the class's extension allotment are applied. It concerns the units granted by the extension itself, not the units the member asks for on an extension request.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- A member in Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid: 3 units are added to the units the extension adds.
- A member in Prairie Ridge ABD Care: 1 unit is added.
- A member in an eligibility category not named in the schedule: nothing is added.
